Chords & Lyrics (Editable) Details
Download the PDF Chord Charts for Your Glory (with Nothing But The Blood) by All Sons & Daughters, from the album All Sons & Daughters Live. This song was arranged by Daniel Galbraith in the key of D, Eb.

SongID	23954
Language	English
Album	All Sons & Daughters Live
Artists	All Sons & Daughters
Authors	Leslie Jordan
Arrangers	Daniel Galbraith
Publishers	Integrity Music
CCLI Song No.	5881068
Instruments	Guitar, Ukelele, Piano
File Type	PDF
Original Key	D
Available Keys	A, Ab, B, Bb, C, C#, D, Db, E, Eb, F, F#, G, G#, Gb, Numbers, Numerals
Meter	4/4
Style	Ballad
Tempo	Slow
Theme	Beauty, Blood, Christian Life, Cleansing, Glory, Hallelujah, Heart, Jesus, Sin, Surrender, Wholeness, Worship, Good Friday
Lyrics
Verse 1
My life is Yours and my hope is in You only
And my heart You hold, 'cause You made this sinner holy
And holy, holy

Chorus 1
'Cause Your glory is so beautiful I fall onto my knees in awe
And the heartbeat of my life is to worship in Your light
'Cause Your glory is so beautiful, 'cause Your glory is so beautiful

Verse 2
My life is Yours and my hope is in You only
And my heart You hold, 'cause You made this sinner holy
And holy, holy

Bridge
Glory glory hallelujah, Jesus You are good

Verse 3
What can wash away my sins, nothing but the blood of Jesus
What can make me whole again, nothing but the blood of Jesus

Chorus 2
And oh precious is the flow, that makes me white as snow
No other fount I know, nothing but the blood of Jesus...
